comment: URLs that serve copies of vega-datasets' data/ directory. The oracle (oracle.mjs) and the engine's test loader (compare_test.go) both read this file, so they map exactly the same URLs to the local copy in testdata/vega-datasets; any other URL fails to load on both sides (offline). Each pattern's first group is the path under testdata/vega-datasets. The syntax is the subset JavaScript and Go (RE2) share.
